stories.title: Fewer than 20 vessels pass through Strait of Hormuz over weekend — Reuters
stories.summary: These figures may change, as some vessels passed through with their transponders switched off, experts from Kpler said
article_sentences: Fewer than two dozen vessels passed through the Strait of Hormuz over the past weekend amid actions by the United States and Iran restricting traffic through the waterway, which is crucial to international energy security, Reuters reported, citing analytics firm Kpler.
According to preliminary data, 13 vessels crossed the strait on August 22 and four the following day.
These figures may change, as some vessels passed through with their transponders switched off, the experts said.
